crmf.title: Find clinics on Google
crmf.lead: Search Google Maps for clinics by specialty and city, bring in their names, addresses, phones, websites and published e-mail, then add them to the CRM.
crmf.key_missing: Add a Places API key to start searching.
crmf.key_help: Create a key in Google Cloud and enable Places API (New) on it. Each search is billed to your Google account.
crmf.emails: Read the e-mail address from the clinic's website
crmf.new_search_sub: For example: dental clinic, dermatology centre, paediatrician. Google returns up to 60 places per search.
crmf.auto: Repeat daily and tell me about new clinics
crmf.searches_sub: A clinic that appears in a repeated search for the first time is marked "New on Google" — often a clinic that just opened.
crmf.delete_confirm: Delete this search? Its places not added to the CRM are removed.
crmf.ran: {found} places found: {added} new to the list, {fresh} on Google for the first time.
crmf.none: Nothing here. Start a new search or run a saved one again.
crmf.none_key: Add the Google Maps key first.
crmf.added: {places} clinics added, {contacts} of them as new contacts.
crmf.note: Data from Google Places and the clinics' public websites. Contact clinics in line with the privacy and marketing laws of their country, and respect anyone who asks not to be contacted.
